en.title: Star Detective Precure! Film Adds Trio of Voice Talent for New Characters
en.summary: The upcoming Precure film unveils its guest cast, bringing fan-favorite voices to its original characters. Get ready for a new adventure hitting screens this September.
en.body:
The **Star Detective Precure!** film is gearing up for its September 18, 2026 release in Japan, and the latest casting news is sure to excite fans. Three new original characters will be brought to life by a trio of talented voice actors, adding even more star power to the franchise’s 35th cinematic installment.

Akari Kito, widely recognized for her role as Nezuko Kamado in **Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba**, will voice Karin. Nobunaga Shimazaki, known for his roles in series like **Fruits Basket** and **My Hero Academia**, steps in as Alan. Rounding out the new additions is Kōki Uchiyama, a veteran voice actor whose credits include **Haikyuu!!** and **Jujutsu Kaisen**, who will portray Rain. These additions suggest a focus on bringing compelling new personalities to the film, complementing the established cast and narrative of the current **Star Detective Precure!** TV series.

The film, officially titled **Eiga Meitantei Precure! Fushigina Niwa to Futari no Himitsu** (Star Detective Precure! The Movie: The Mysterious Garden and the Secret of the Two), continues the adventures of Anna Akechi. The series itself has captivated audiences with its unique premise: Anna time-slips from 2027 to 1999, where she befriends Mikuru and together they become Detective Precure, solving mysteries and uncovering secrets. The integration of these new characters into the film’s plot is anticipated to add new layers to the ongoing story, potentially impacting Anna and Mikuru's journey.

## Fan Excitement Builds for New Voices

For dedicated Precure fans, the casting of popular voice actors is always a significant event. The **Star Detective Precure!** film is no exception. The inclusion of **Akari Kito**, **Nobunaga Shimazaki**, and **Kōki Uchiyama** is likely to generate considerable buzz within the community. These actors bring with them established fanbases and proven track records of delivering memorable performances. Their roles as Karin, Alan, and Rain will undoubtedly be scrutinized and celebrated by viewers eager to see how these new characters interact with the main cast and contribute to the film's overarching mystery. The Precure franchise has a long history of featuring compelling guest characters, and this latest ensemble promises to uphold that tradition.

## What's Next for Detective Precure

With the release date set for September 18, 2026, fans can anticipate further promotional material, including trailers and visuals, in the coming months. The film’s ending theme song, "First Prism," performed as a duet by **Yuka Masui** (who sings the TV series' ending theme) and **Chihaya**, has already been featured, offering a glimpse into the movie's musical tone. The anticipation is high to see how these new characters and their voice actors will contribute to the beloved Precure universe.

content_raw: Akari Kitō, Nobunaga Shimazaki, Kōki Uchiyama join cast of film opening on September 18
